in_sanskrit.name: Bhauma
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bhauma is a Sanskrit word meaning 'Earth'. It is derived from the root 'bhau' which means 'to be' or 'to exist'. The prefix 'bha-' denotes the object or the substance that exists or is present. So, Bhauma means 'that which exists as the Earth'.

in_hindi.name: Bhaumi
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Earth
in_hindi.long_meaning: Bhaumi एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Bhaumi comes from the Sanskrit word Bhumi, meaning 'earth'. It is a name that represents the connection between the physical and spiritual worlds, and the nurturing and grounding energy of the earth.
